appliesTo: Every station, plow, armor and future model

requires: Inventory every visible shape
Record measured image landmarks separately from estimated 3D dimensions
Resolve common axes, scale, camera, positions, rotations, dimensions and attachment endpoints
Enumerate repeated parts rather than hide them in generic group descriptions
Validate projected contours and occlusion relationships against reference before Blender
Build from validated geometry plan
Render without textures, bump or emission
Compare full composition and individual components
Correct geometry and revalidate until reference shapes match
Inventory materials per component
Specify reference color observations with lighting uncertainty
Specify roughness and metallic behavior per material
Separate modeled relief from normal-map detail
Define wear location, scale, direction and intensity
Plan UV islands, seams, density and 2048-square map allocation
Declare color spaces and normal-map convention
Define neutral and reference-like comparison lighting
Validate material plan against reference before creating textures
Apply validated texture plan at 2K
Inspect actual saved model under comparison lighting
Verify all materials and overall reference fidelity
Inspect imported geometry and material mapping
Verify actual render and camper fit
Coordinate shared builds and installation
Never install an unaccepted candidate

acceptance: Written plans, numeric checks and successful renders are evidence, not automatic visual acceptance. Preserve failures and explain actual remaining differences.
